conceptZh: 爸爸或媽媽的媽媽，或年長女性的稱呼。
object: a chunky red toy fire engine, its crew, a runaway hose, and a copycat mini fire engine
morph: a copycat mini engine mirrors every move one beat late, spraying the pieces of 婆 into place
creativeAngle: 小消防車模仿大車慢一拍，水柱把「波」與「女」噴到定位；迎出外婆玩偶。
promptEn: An 8-second silly animated clip, bright pastel look, soft daylight, no dark grading. In a sky-blue toy town square with a lemon-yellow fire station, a chunky red toy fire engine with a floppy hose is followed everywhere by a little copycat fire engine that moves one beat behind. 0–1.7s: The big engine swings its hose left as the first 婆 is spoken; the little engine swings its tiny hose a beat late, squirting the big engine's bumper, who gives a puzzled blink. 1.7–3.3s: The big engine honks and reverses; the little one honks and reverses a beat late, bumping it, and the second 婆 is spoken as the hose coils up on its own and sprays a jet of water forming the top 波 part. 3.3–4.9s: Both engines rotate to spray at once, but the little one aims at the wrong side, so the big engine's jet draws 女 and the mix-up sends a rainbow spray: the full 婆 appears in deep rose. 4.9–5.8s: As 外婆 is spoken, the fire station door opens and a silver-bun toy grandma in a shawl waves from a window, and both engines flash lights in sync. Final hold (about 5.0–8.0s): both engines blink in perfect unison at last, then the hose gives a tiny curl; the glyph stays perfectly still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly this line, slowly and distinctly with the marked tones, then stops: 婆、婆、外婆（ㄆㄛˊ、ㄆㄛˊ、ㄨㄞˋ ㄆㄛˊ）. The first 婆 lands at about 1.0s, the second 婆 at about 2.8s, and the word 外婆 at about 4.9s, each timed to the picture described above. Keep 婆 as the one and only piece of writing on screen, a bold saturated color against a pale bright background, correctly formed with every stroke legible; nothing else is written anywhere. The glyph 婆 fills roughly 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped, and stays perfectly still for the final 3 seconds while the lead keeps playing away from the strokes. No real people, no flashing.

conceptZh: 橡膠恐龍聞到外婆家飄出的饅頭香，手太短敲不到門，只好整隻衝過去撞門；撞散的木板和屋檐水滴掉下來排成「婆」，外婆開門探頭，把饅頭放在牠鼻子上。
object: a round wooden cottage door with a dripping roof gutter, charged head-on by a rubber dinosaur with huge feet and uselessly tiny arms
morph: the BONK shakes three gutter drops loose as 氵, the door's planks tumble and stack as 皮 beside them, and the door frame beams and welcome-mat ribbon drop below as 女, locking into one solid deep-rose 婆
creativeAngle: 前一版是兩台消防車的模仿鬧劇，角色多、笑點散。這版改成單一肢體大笑點：短手恐龍敲不到門，只能用全身撞門，撞擊本身把門板和水滴震成「婆」。詞「外婆」說出的瞬間，玩偶外婆從門邊探頭出現，聽到的和看到的完全對應。不需要機器人配角，畫面只有恐龍、門、外婆三樣。
promptEn: An 8-second slapstick animated clip, bright pastel look, soft daylight, no dark grading. Setting: a flat mint-green lawn in front of a cream cottage wall; centered in frame is a big round wooden cottage door, honey-colored planks with a tiny roof gutter above it dripping water. The lead is a chubby rubber dinosaur, teal with a yellow belly, enormous flat feet and comically tiny arms that cannot reach anything, so it does everything with its whole body. 0–1.5s: The dinosaur stands at the far left, sniffing a curl of cartoon steam drifting out from under the door. It wants in. It trots up and tries to knock, but its tiny arms flap a full hand's width short of the wood; it stretches on tiptoe, flaps again, misses again, and puffs its cheeks. The first 婆 is spoken at about 1.0s as its big feet dig twin skid marks into the lawn. 1.5–3.0s: Try and miss, bigger: it leans in to bump the door with its forehead, over-leans, tips backward onto its tail and boings upright like a rubber ball. Then the real wind-up: it stomps back to the left edge, leans way back until it is almost horizontal, feet churning in place, eyes locked on the door, one frozen beat of anticipation. 3.0–4.5s: CHARGE straight across the frame left to right and a huge squashy BONK into the door. The dinosaur squashes flat as a pancake against the wood. The impact shakes everything loose: three drops leap off the gutter and hang as the 氵 dots at the upper left, the door's planks tumble and stack beside them as 皮, and the door-frame beams and the welcome-mat ribbon drop below and cross as 女. At about 4.2s the second 婆 is spoken exactly as all the pieces lock into one solid deep-rose glyph 婆, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with clear margins. 4.5–5.5s: The flattened dinosaur peels off the ground at the lower left, re-inflates with a wobble and a dizzy cross-eyed grin, little stars circling its head. At about 5.0s the word 外婆 is spoken exactly as a toy grandmother figure, a chunky plastic figurine with a silver bun, round glasses and a floral apron, pops out from the open doorway at the right edge of the glyph holding a steaming white bun, hands on hips, then softening into a smile. Final hold (5.0–8.0s): the glyph 婆 stays perfectly still and readable; off to the right the grandmother figure holds out the bun, the dinosaur reaches with its tiny arms and cannot come close, so she plops it on its nose and it balances the bun there, wagging its tail with a happy wiggle, never touching or covering the strokes. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly this line, slowly and distinctly with the marked tones, then stops: 婆、婆、外婆（ㄆㄛˊ、ㄆㄛˊ、ㄨㄞˋ ㄆㄛˊ）. No other speech, no music louder than the voice, soft cartoon boing and bonk effects only, nothing loud or startling. Keep 婆 as the one and only piece of writing on screen, correctly formed with every stroke legible, a bold saturated deep rose against the pale background; no subtitles, no other text, no watermark, no flashing. Only stylized toy figures and cartoon creatures, no real people.
